subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should UX-012 remain a separate composer-base progress meter now that current main has a context ring/popover with token and cost details, or should this branch be folded into that existing surface?
rationale: The source defect is mechanically clear, but the current-main UI has moved and now overlaps the requested feature enough that the permanent product surface needs owner intent before repair work is useful.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Context UI
options.body: Rebase the branch into ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer.ts and drive any meter from the existing freshness-aware context model.

options.title: Keep A Separate Meter
options.body: Maintain a distinct 2px composer-base meter, but require stale-state styling/tests and product copy that explains how it differs from the context popover.

options.title: Retire This Branch
options.body: Treat the merged context usage details as the preferred UX and close or replace this PR with a narrower follow-up only if a visible gap remains.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Existing Context UI
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch into ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer.ts and drive any meter from the existing freshness-aware context model.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged context popover work makes steipete the best available owner for deciding whether this separate meter still fits the current composer UX.
